Commentary.Commentary: Before the chase begin, Devon Conway is up for a quick chat. He says that the pitch was tricky but as soon as he got used to the wicket the stroke-making became easy. He mentions that they were looking for a score around 160 mark but they are happy with 173 on the board.

Right! Pakistan have not chased in this series yet and it is the chance for them. Skipper Shadab at the toss said that they have added more depth to the batting so it will be interesting to see how they turn up. The Kiwis will be high on confidence and will believe that their bowlers will defend the score to whitewash the visitors. Join us for the second innings in a bit.

Pakistan looked to have things under control after the Powerplay but they were hammered for a few towards the end. Afridi and Rauf did get a couple of wickets each but the duo gave 87 runs between them. It was Faheem who was the best for Pakistan as he ended up with 3/20. Shadab did well too but failed to get any wicket.

Earlier in the game, Shadab once again won the toss but this time he decided to bowl first. New Zealand got a great start with Guptill and Seifert adding 40 for the first wicket. Guptill was the first man to depart and skipper Williamson followed him soon without making any impact with the bat. Seifert too couldn't continue the way he did in the last game and fell for 35 off 20 deliveries. Conway and Phillips then got things under control as the duo added 50-plus with Phillips being the aggressor. Phillips fell but Conway continued and went bang bang as he scored 63 to take the team towards a big score.

A strong batting display from the Kiwis! They started well, the middle order was put under pressure at one point but Phillips and Conway managed to pull things back well and in the end, the Kiwis have got a fine score on the board.
Misfield and an extra taken! Full and outside off, Southee manages to squeeze it down to deep cover where the fielder fumbles and they run for a couple. New Zealand end with 173/7.
Good running! Fuller and on middle, pushed throgh mid on for a brace.
Slower and short ball outside off, Southee swings ealry but makes no connection.
Kyle Jamieson with the bat now.
OUT! CAUGHT! This time Conway has to go. A slower fuller one around off, Conway looks to hit it on the leg side again but he ends up slicing it towards cover. Shadab Khan takes the dolly.

In the air... safe! A short ball, Conway look to pull but gets a top edge. The keeper goes after it and the man on the leg side does too but Rizwan stops and doesn't go for it, despite having the gloves. The fielder tries to fails to get hands. Two taken.
Just a single off the Free Hit. A slower bumper. Southee doesn't connect the pull well. It goes high in the air and they cross.

NO BALL! That's a nasty beamer from Rauf. First no ball of the series. It was an attempted slower yorker but looked like it slipped out of his hand. Southee did well to get out of the way. Free Hit coming up.
Length ball around off, Southee shuffles around the off side and flicks it towards fine leg for a single. He will keep the strike in the last over. 16 off the penultimate over.
Full and on middle, flicked down to long on for a single. Southee wanted the second but Conway says no.
FOUR! Conway nails the drive through the covers! Third time against Shaheen. A fuller one outside off, Conway hits it hard through the cover region for a boundary.
Tim Southee is the new man in with the bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kuggeleijn falls this time! Another one which was in the hitting zone but Kuggeleijn fails to connect it well this time. It goes high in the air towards long on where Iftikhar settles under it and takes it easily.
SIX! BANG! Kuggeleijn on the charge! A length ball again from Afridi, it is right in the slot. Kuggeleijn powers it over deep mid-wicket for half a dozen. 10 off the first 2.
FOUR! WOW! That is some power! A length ball right in the slot, Kuggeleijn hammers the flick using his bottom hand to hit it right in the gap at long on and deep mid-wicket.
Shaheen Afridi to bowl out. 3-0-27-1 from him so far.
FOUR! Glorious from Conway! Full and outside off, Conway hits it through mid off. The man is inside the ring there but it is hit wide of him. 16 off the over.
Superb yorker but Kuggeleijn does well to get bat on ball. It goes off the outside edge towards short third man and they cross.
A slower one from Rauf this time. Conway reads it well and pushes it towards point for one.
SIX! Flicked and flicked for a biggie! Half ton for Conway with a lovely shot. A fuller ball on middle and leg, Conway flicks and clears the rope at deep mid-wicket. Stunning stroke.
Fuller and around middle, pushed to the left of the bowler. Rauf gets down and does well to make a half stop. They don't go for the run.
FOUR! Slammed through cover-point. A low full toss outside off, Conway hits it hard and beats the diving deep cover fielder.
Haris Rauf to bowl his 3rd over. 2-0-20-1 from him so far.
A couple to end a top spell from Faheem. Short and around middle, Kuggeleijn pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for a single. 3/20 in his 4 overs.
Length and around off, pushed towards cover for a quick single.
Short and around off, pulled down to long on for a single.
Short and outside off, Conway pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Scott Kuggeleijn with the bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Faheem gets another one! Neesham is the man to depart. A fuller and just outside off, Neesham looks to tonk it over long on but ends up miscuing it. It goes high in the air towards mid off where the Pakistan skipper takes the catch easily.
A slower one from Faheem. It is short as well. Neesham looks to pull but he is early in his attempt. Misses to get hit high on the pad.
Faheem Ashraf is back on. 3-0-15-2 from him so far.
On the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one. 8 off the 16th over.
Length and outside off, dabbed down to third man for one.
Excellent running! Length ball around off, Conway pushes it towards long on. The fielder is slow to get to the ball and they sneak a couple.
FOUR! Nicely done! Short and on middle, Conway nails the pull wide of the man at deep mid-wicket.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Conway looks to cut but misses.
Appeal for caught behind by the keeper but nothing much from the bowler. A length ball just around off, Conway pokes at it but misses. Rizwan appeals but not out says the umpire.
Short and wide outside off, slapped to deep cover for a single. 11 runs and a wicket from the over.
Neesham runs down the short ball down to third man for a single to get off the mark.
Banged short, pulled down to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Action replay of the last shot! Stunning! Full and just outside off, Conway creams it through the covers again. It races away to the fence.
FOUR! Drilled through the covers! Full and just outside off, Conway nails the drive through the cover region for a boundary.
James Neesham comes on to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Afridi strikes on the first ball of his new spell. Big wicket as Phillips falls. A slower one from Afridi. It is full and right in the slot as Phillips looks to go big down the ground. He gets more height than distance as it goes high in the air.
Shaheen Afridi comes back on. 2-0-16-0 from him so far.
Shortish and around middle, Phillips looks to pull but misses to get hit on the pad. The ball rolls towards the leg side and they sneak a leg bye. Just 4 from the over. A good one form Hasnain.
A single and it brings up 50-run stand. Back of a length, tucked around square leg for a run.
Goes for the pull again but he is beaten for pace once again.
Top delivery! Hasnain bangs it short and lands it around middle, Conway gets down the track and looks to hit it on the off side but misses.
Short and wide, Phillips looks to cut but gets an inside edge that goes towards short fine leg. A single.
Shortish and around off, tucked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Mohammad Hasnain comes onto bowl now. 2-0-18-0 from him so far.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries. Short and on middle, Phillips pulls it hard and hits it right in the gap at deep mid-wicket and deep square leg. 15 off the over. Shadab ends the day. 36/0 in his 4.
FOUR! 100 up in style! Short and wide again from Shadab. Phillips slams it again. No chance for the man at deep cover again.
Flatter and outside off, poked towards mid off for a single.
Around off, pushed towards cover for one.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! Talat is the man at point. Poor from him. Shortish and outside off, Phillips cuts it hard but it is hit straight at Talat who fails to stop and gives away a boundary.
Full and on middle, flicked to long on for one.

FOUR! Shot! Short and wide outside off, Phillips slams it through cover-point and it races away. There was a fielder at deep cover and he ran to his left but he had no chance. Top shot to end the over.
Length ball around off, pushed towards mid off for one.
We are all set to resume the play. Haris Rauf to continue the over

A halt in play. The umpires converge to halt the play as the sun sets here at Napier. We have seen it before also and once again we see it here. The sun seems to come directly in the eyes of the batsmen which has lead to a halt in play as the Umpires and Players take some drinks.
Shortish and around middle, tucked towards the leg side for one.

Straight as a barrel but just a single! Full and straight around off, Conway drives off the front foot and hits it straight to the stumps at the bowler's end. The ball though deflects of the stumps to the off side. A single is what the batsmen get.
Shortish length ball outside off, Philips miscues this pull which just falls short of the long on fielder.
A bouncer on middle, Conway looks to pull but the ball gets a bit big. He manages to get some bat and get to the other end as the ball goes towards short fine leg.
Haris Rauf is back on. 1-0-11-1 so far from him.
Fuller and around off, driven to the right of the long off fielder who does well to get to the ball quickly. Just a run on the last ball and 5 from the over. A tight one from Shadab.
Floated on middle, pushed to the left of the bowler but Conway. They think for the single but Shadab quickly gets to the ball and keeps the batters at the same end.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point.

Good save! Excellent work from Rauf to save a run for the side. Shortish and just outside off, Phillips looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge that races towards the third man fence. Rauf from short third man gives it a chase and does really well to pull the ball in with a dive. The third umpire has been called for and replays show he hs done a terrific job there.
Flatter and around off, pushed towards short fine leg for one.

NOT OUT! Ultra Edge detects a spike as the ball gets close to the bat. This was floated on the pads, Conway got down for the sweep but he missed it to get hit on the pad. They appealed but not out was the call from the umpire. This time Shadab has a word with his wicket-keeper and they go for the DRS. Let's see what we have got. Here comes the Ultra Edge. There is bat on ball as it shows a deflection. We don't need the Ball Tracker. Pakistan lose the review as the onfied call stays.

Review Time! Shadab Khan has opted for a review for LBW against Conway. Lets see what the replays have to show. It's a fair delivery as the Ultra Edge comes on. Ohh! There is a spike when the ball is near the bat. A review lost.
Single to end the over! Short and around middle, Conway pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for one. 76/3 at the end of the halfway mark.
Short and wide outside off, slashes towards point fielder who does well to stop it but gives away the single.
Good length ball on the stumps, Glenn punches it back to the bowler.
Good length ball outside off, guided towards third man for a single.
GOOD FIELDING IN THE DEEP! Short and wide outside off, Conway throws his bat and hits it hard towards deep point to collect a couple as the fielder does well to stop it.
FOUR! Hammered! Fuller ball on the stumps, Conwa comes down the track and then lofts this over the mid off fielder to collect a boundary at long off on the bounce.
Fuller and around off, pushed through covers for one.

An appeal but turned down! Tossed up and around middle and leg. Conway goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pad. A loud appeal but nothing from the umpire. No review from Pakistan. Replays show it pitched outside leg. So, a good call from the umpire as well as the Pakistani skipper.

Sloppy from Pakistan! That was a dot ball but a poor throw from the man at backward point means the Kiwis get one. Flatter and around off, poked towards backward point. The throw is a wild one and Rizwan cannot collect.

In the air... safe! Three fielders ran to take the catch but none of them could get to it. Tossed up and around off, Phillips looks to go big over the bowler's head but he doesn't get the timing as well as he would've liked. The ball goes high in the air but it lands safely near the rope.
Connects the drive past the bowler this time. The mid on fielder does well to make a diving stop and save two.
Tossed up full and outside off, Phillips looks to drive but misses as it turns away.
Good length ball on middle, punched towards mid on for a single to end the over.
Fuller ball outside off, Devon drives it through the covers for a single.

Almost another one for Faheem. A shortish length and just outside off, Phillips looks to defend but the ball takes the inner half and goes past the stick towards the left of the keeper as they sneak a single.
Fuller and around off, pushed towards mid off.
Glenn Phillips is the new man in with the bat.

OUT! TIMBER AGAIN! Faheem removes the man in form. Lovely stuff from him. Perfect line and length. It is around off on a good length, Seifert looks to punch but the ball nips back in enough to beat the bat and then it goes to take the top of off. Good, little innings from Seifert is over.
Full and around off, driven through point for one.

In the air... safe! Rauf lost the ball in the light it seemed. Fuller and around off, Seifert looks to drive it over long off but the connection is not proper. It goes towards long off where Rauf fails to spot the ball. Doesn't cost him much though but had he spotted the ball early, he would've got some chance. Two taken. 10 from the first over of the spinner.
Shortish and outside off, pushed towards point.
Full and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and outside off, stroked through cover-point for a run.

SIX! Risky shot with the fielder back but Seifert clears the rope. A floated delivery around off, Seifert gets down and sweeps. He doesn't get it off the middle of the bat as it flows off the top edge but it clears the man at deep square leg.
Floated around off from Shadab, Seifert pushes it back to the bowler.
Shadab Khan brings himself on now.
Length ball around off, pushed towards mid on for a run. Just the 2 runs and the huge wicket of Williamson in this last over of the Powerplay. 47/2 are the Kiwis at the end of the first 6.
Good single and Conway is off the mark. Fuller and around off, pushed towards cover for a quick single.
Beaten first ball. A shortish length ball outside off, it comes back in and beats the inside edge of Conway as he looks to punch.
Devon Conway comes out to bat now. A rare sight of the Kiwi middle order coming into bat in this series. How will they fare?

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Faheem strikes and it is the massive wicket of the Kiwi skipper. He leaves the field without making an impact in this game. A shortish ball just outside off, it is too close to cut but Williamson looks to do that and ends up dragging the ball onto the sticks. Wickets in consecutive overs for Pakistan.
A length ball around off, the slower one from Faheem. Kane works it towards mid-wicket.
Shortish and just outside off, punched towards cover-point.
Faheem Ashraf comes onto bowl now.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Poor from Afridi at mid on. A fuller ball around off, Seifert punches it to the left of the man at mid on who dives to stop but fails to do so. The ball races away to the fence at long on. 11 runs from the over but the wicket of Guptill in it as well.
Good length ball around off, Seifert punches this one straight to the covers.
Good length ball outside off, guided down to third man for a single. Williamson is off the mark.
Kane Williamson, the New Zealand skipper walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Rauf gets his revenge! He runs in and bowls a fuller one around off, Guptill looks to hit it over mid off once again but this time he doesn't connect it well. It goes off the toe end to the right side of the man at mid on. Shadab Khan, the Pakistani skipper, makes no mistake. Rauf is fired up.

SIX! BAMMED! Guptill does it with minimal effort there! Fuller and around off, Martin stands still and brings out the full face of the bat as he lofts it over mid off. The ball has enough on it to sail over the fence on the full. A biggie earned.
Fuller length ball on middle, flicked straight to mid on
Haris Rauf comes as the first change. He replaces Shaheen Afridi.
SIX! That's a baseball hit! A short ball outside off, Seifert stays in his crease and hammers it over the bowler's head for a maximun.
Short and wide outside off, Seifert looks to cut but misses.
Shortish this time, tucked to deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! Poor ball and he gets the punishment! Strays on the pad on a good length, Martin flicks it to the right side of the man at short fine leg. That raced to the fence in a jiffy.
A length delivery around off and middle, Guptill looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit high on the pad.
Swing and a miss! A length ball outside off, Guptill goes for the massive slog but makes no connection.
A single to end! Strays on the pads does Afridi and Guptill flicks it to deep square leg. 11 off the over.
FOUR! A short ball around middle and leg, Guptill swivels and pulls it down towards fine leg. One bounce and into the fence. This is turning out to be a great over for the hosts.
Shortish and around off, pushed towards point.
Three this time! A fuller ball on the pads, Seifert flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder from mid on gives it a chase and slides to keep the ball in the play.
In the air... safe! A fuller ball around off, Seifert lifts it straight over the bowler's head. Doesn't connect it as well as he would've liked but it clears mid off and mid on. Two taken.
Short ball around off, pulled down to deep square leg for a run.
Play and a miss again! Short and wide outside off, Seifert looks to cut but makes no connection.
SIX! WOW! That is a stunning stroke! Gives the bowler charge, makes some room and slapped the short ball outside off over cover for a biggie. First one of the game.
Shortish and around off, blocked back to the bowler. Tight line from Hasnain so far.
Play and a miss! Good length and just outside off, Seifert looks to punch it on the up but he misses.
Length delivery around off, worked towards mid-wicket.
Misfield and a run! A shortish length ball outside off, Guptill punches it towards cover where the fielder fails to collect the ball cleanly. A single taken.
Who will it be from the other end with the ball? Mohammad Hasnain it will be.
Dot to end the over! A length ball around off, pushed towards mid-wicket. 5 off the opening over. A decent one from Afridi.

FOUR! BOOM! First ball and a perfect cover drive! Super shot from the man in form. A fuller length and just outside off, Seifert gets on the front foot and creams the drive through the cover region. Stunning shot to get off the mark.
A short ball this time and Guptill plays a controlled pull down to deep square leg. A single and he is up and running.
A ripper this time! A slower one from him. He pitches around middle and off, Guptill pokes at it but it moves away a touch to beat the outside edge.
Full and outside off this time, Guptill looks to drive but gets it off the inner half.
A good length delivery around off and middle, Guptill hits it to the right side of the bowler. Afridi tries to get his hands around but he fails to do that as the ball rolls towards mid on.

We are all set to begin as Shadab Khan has a few words to say to his players before they spread on the field taking their respective fielding positions. Out come the two New Zealand openers, Tim Seifert and Martin Guptill. Shaheen Afridi to start with the ball. Here we go...

Ish Sodhi who is playing his 50th T20I game is in for a chat now. He says that he is excited and proud for his 50th game in the format. Says he didn't dream to play 50 matches. Says Spinners bowl a lot of middle overs and have a lot of chances to take wickets. Mentions that the spinners have variations like turning the ball both ways, thereby making it difficult for batsmen. Tells that he always discusses with Santner what length to bowl depending upon the ground dimensions. Reckons his strength is to bowl from a height and using the bounce of the pitch. Informs that he tries to hide the googly as much as he can.

New Zealand coach, Gary Stead, is caught for a quick chat. He tells that introduction of new players have been excellent. Adds that seeing them come and put good performances is pleasing. Says that confidence is growing in the team. Tells that ranking doesn't really matter much. Mentions that they are building towards the World Cup next year in India. On the Test series coming up, Gary says that Pakistan have a quality spinner in Yasir Shah and terms visitors a tough side.

Pitch report - Craig McMillan and Jeetan Patel are in with pitch report. McMillan informs that the weather here has been pleasent and there shouldn't be any issue with that regard. Adds that it looks hard and dry and will be good for batting. Patel says that the wicket might offer some assistance to the spinners. Adds that the boundaries are long down the ground so the plan should be to bowl full rather than short.

New Zealand (UNCHANGED PLAYING XI) - Martin Guptill, Tim Seifert (WK), Kane Williamson (C), Devon Conway, Glenn Phillips, James Neesham, Kyle Jamieson, Scott Kuggeleijn, Tim Southee, Ish Sodhi, Trent Boult.

Kane Williamson, New Zealand skipper, says that the wicket is usually good here and hopes to put on a good performance. Says that they have put on a good show so far and hopes that continues here. Adds that there are always areas of improvement. Ends by saying that every game is important. Informs they are unchanged.

Pakistan (Playing XI): Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Haider Ali, Shadab Khan (C), Mohammad Hafeez, Hussain Talat (IN FOR ABDULLAH SHAFIQUE), Iftikhar Ahmed (IN FOR WAHAB RIAZ), Khushdil Shah, Faheem Ashraf, Haris Rauf, Shaheen Afridi, Mohammad Hasnain (IN FOR IMAD WASIM).

Shadab Khan, the Pakistan skipper, says that they have three changes in the team and have got depth in batting and hence they want to chase. Informs they have three changes for this game. Says that the condition here is different and adds that the bounce here in New Zealand is different and a number of their players are coming here for the first time. Praises Hafeez and adds that he has been in superb form since last year. Tells that the young guns from the team need to learn from him.

TOSS - Time for the flip of the coin here at McLean Park. The two skippers, Shadab Khan and Kane Williamson are out in the middle along with the match referee, Jeff Crowe. Up she goes and lands in favour of Shadab Khan. PAKISTAN ELECT TO BOWL FIRST!

The final T20I of the year is here. Though it is a dead rubber but the excitement and enjoyment is to the fullest. Pakistan after conceding the series 2-0 would look to play a free brand of cricket as they have only to play for pride. Whereas, New Zealand would be eyeing another whitewash at home to extend their winning momentum to a dozen games across formats. Will we see both teams go with the tried and tested formula or see them test their bench strength? Answers to be revealed shortly at the toss.
